primary_justification: The 2024-03-31 BlackRock packet contains true current-period position rows such as Discovery Purchaser Corporation, Geo Parent Corporation, TruGreen Limited Partnership, and HUB International Limited whose source coordinates show borrower, instrument, rate, maturity, principal, cost, fair value, and percent-of-net-assets fields. The same packet also includes terminal percentage total/category labels; the reconciliation patch classifies these rollups as documented source-only non-position rows rather than production holdings.
